scopeNotes: One row per distinct verified build; repeated 2702949 occurrences remain in the folder table.
Gameplay cells describe packaged workflows or compiled defaults, not live feature acceptance.
Request counts mean public message names ending Request; retained request field schemas match baseline, with TokenBalanceRequest deprecation metadata differing in some older builds.
Static numeric totals are verified table headers unless marked decoded. Larger inherited or unpublished catalogs do not establish more playable content.
Missing cached payloads are not logical resource removals; matching request schemas do not establish event/internal/native compatibility.
